content.text: 5. REMOVE OIL FILLER CAP AND CYLINDER HEAD COVER OF EXHAUST SIDE

items: (a) Turn the crankshaft clockwise and set the No. 1 cylinder to TDC/compression.
(b) Confirm the matchmarks of the camshaft timing pulleys are aligned with those of the No. 3 timing belt cover.

content.description: Illustration showing camshaft timing pulleys with matchmarks indicated by arrows
Two detailed views showing timing belt alignment - left side labeled 'Less than one tooth', right side labeled 'More than one tooth', with arrows pointing to the alignment differences

content.text: • If there is more than timing pulley one tooth between the matchmarks, realign the matchmarks in accordance with step 7.
• If the matchmarks are aligned or the difference is less than one timing pulley tooth proceed to step 8.
7. ADJUSTMENT OF CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEY MARKS

items: (a) Loosen the idler pulley set bolt a little and shift the idler pulley to the alternator side with a screwdriver and wrench.
(b) Finger tighten the idler pulley set bolt.
(c) Remove the timing belt from the camshaft timing pulleys.

content.description: Illustration showing the idler pulley location and adjustment with an arrow indicating the direction

items: (d) Using SST, rotate the camshaft timing pulley with the camshaft and align the matchmarks.
(e) Install the timing belt while the engine is cold.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used on camshaft timing pulleys to align matchmarks
